fieldValues.title: A research loop proposes references and fact checks as unaffirmed suggestions
fieldValues.move: The writer sets up an agent loop whose brief says what to check and where to look. What it finds lands in the essay's references pool as a candidate marked with the agent and the time, never as accepted. A doubted claim becomes a comment with its evidence, and the writer ticks or denies in place.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Whether a claim holds (the evidence-line remedy), and how a loop writes while the editor is closed.
fieldValues.falsifier: A loop runs while the writer is away and the writer still has to find or sort its findings by hand, or cannot tell which agent found a reference.
